fix.stripNumericConfirm:
This will remove {{count}} numeric Workshop IDs from Mods= (they belong in WorkshopItems=). Restart required.

Proceed?
fix.stripNumericNoteCount: Removes {{count}} numeric IDs from Mods=. Restart required.
fix.stripNumericNote: Removes numeric Workshop IDs from Mods=. Restart required.
fix.reviewUnresolvedNote: Fix orphan Workshop items first (below), then re-run diagnostics. Disable manually only if entries still do not resolve after downloads finish.
fix.autoFixWorkshopConfirm:
This will triage {{count}} Workshop items: downloaded items are added to Mods=; ignored or missing items are removed from WorkshopItems=. The server must restart for changes to take effect.

Proceed?
fix.autoFixWorkshopNoteCount: Triages {{count}} Workshop items: enables downloaded mods and drops ignored or missing IDs. Restart required.
fix.autoFixWorkshopNote: Triages Workshop items: enables downloaded mods and drops ignored or missing IDs. Restart required.
fix.repairMapNote: Removes invalid Map= entries and re-adds detected map folders. Restart required.
fix.deduplicateNote: Removes duplicate Mods= entries. Restart required.
fix.openModsNote: Re-check Workshop downloads and remove or replace the failing mod, then restart.
fix.startServerNote: Starts the dedicated server using the active configuration.
fix.activeServerNote: Select or configure an active server with a valid install path.
fix.zomboidDataNote: Set the Zomboid data path in Settings.
fix.serverFinderNote: Re-run server detection or reinstall the dedicated server files.
fix.serverConfigNote: Configure server settings to generate or repair the .ini files.
fix.repairSandboxNote: Attempts an automated repair (missing block header or comma). A backup of the broken file is saved first. If the corruption does not match a known pattern, nothing is written.
fix.rconPasswordNote: Set the RCON password in Server Config and use the matching value in Settings.
fix.bridgeModNote: Re-deploy the PanelBridge mod via Server Finder.
fix.configDriftNote: Reload the panel config from server.ini, or push your changes back to disk.
fix.deleteStaleLocksConfirm:
This will delete every *.lock file older than 1 hour in the active save folder. The server must be stopped first.

Proceed?
fix.deleteStaleLocksNote: Stopping the server is not automated — make sure it is stopped first. Then stale .lock files are deleted.
fix.viewCrashLogsNote: Opens the Crash Logs tab on this page for the latest stack trace.
fix.reconnectRconNote: Tries to reconnect to RCON using the saved password. If it still fails, check that the password in Server Config matches Settings, then restart the server.
fix.servicesNote: Restarting the panel usually clears stuck services.
fix.discordNote: Check the bot token and intents in Discord settings.
fix.bridgeNote: Re-deploy PanelBridge, ensure the server is running, and check write permissions on the bridge folder.
fix.databaseNote: Verify the data directory path exists and the panel can write to it.
fix.createDatabaseBackupNote: Creates a manual database backup now. Schedule recurring backups from the Backups page.
fix.logsNote: Verify the logs directory path exists and is writable.
fix.diskNote: Free up disk space — delete old backups or clean unused chunks.
fix.storageNote: Trim the save by removing unreachable chunks.
fix.runtimeNote: Restarting the panel reclaims heap. Close other processes if host RAM is exhausted.
fix.timeSkewNote: Sync the host system clock (NTP / Windows Time service) and re-run diagnostics.
fix.panelUpdatesNote: Panel updates are managed from Settings → Updates.
fix.modUpdatesNote: Review and apply Workshop mod updates from the Mods page.
fix.steamApiNote: Verify outbound internet access to api.steampowered.com.
fix.openSuggestedFix: Open the suggested page and apply the listed fix.
fix.restartHint: Restart the server to apply the changes.
fix.noNumericEntries: No numeric Mods= entries were provided by diagnostics.
fix.noOrphanIds: No orphan Workshop IDs were provided by diagnostics.
fix.serverStartSent: Dedicated server start signal sent. Check the Dashboard for status.
